performance.verdict: Meta working; Google burning $507 with zero returns — fix before scaling anything.

findings.text: Google Ads spent $507.22 over 28 days with zero conversions — confirmed spend leak, not a pixel gap (clicks landed: 112).
5 overdue SOW milestones (Jul 20–Aug 31): Stripe QA, GHL build closure, stack re-test, paid landing pages, and UGC batch — all unverified, two are ⛔ scaling blockers.
GBP: 83 impressions and 41 direction actions over 28 days but 0 calls — call button misconfigured or tracking broken; down 50% week-on-week.
Meta 3-day signal (Sep 8–10): leads 10+12+6=28 vs prior 3 (Sep 5–7): 0+0+6=6 — strong positive momentum at ~$86/day spend; CPL holding near $15.85 baseline.
GHL returned a 401 timeout error today — pipeline data unavailable; cannot confirm whether 138 leads over 28 days are entering as opportunities or leaking at intake.

suggestions.text: Pause Google Ads immediately — $507.22 spent, 0 conversions over 28 days is confirmed total waste.
suggestions.monday_update: Google Ads has spent $507.22 over 28 days and generated zero conversions with 112 clicks landing — this is a confirmed spend leak, not a tracking gap. Pause all Google campaigns now and hold budget in reserve. Success check: zero further Google spend until conversion tracking is verified end-to-end. Re-evaluate by 2026-09-18 once tracking is confirmed or a root cause is identified.

suggestions.text: Fix GBP call button tracking — 83 impressions, 41 directions, 0 calls is a confirmed misconfiguration, not user behavior.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP recorded 83 impressions and 41 direction actions over 28 days but zero calls — the call button is either missing, pointed to the wrong number, or call-click tracking is broken in the profile. Assign to ops/web to audit the GBP listing call action and confirm the number matches the live tracking number. Success check: at least one tracked call appearing within 7 days of the fix. Re-check 2026-09-18.

suggestions.text: Watch Meta CPL through Sep 14 — 3-day lead surge (28 leads) must hold before any budget increase is justified.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta's last 3 days (Sep 8–10) produced 28 leads versus 6 in the prior 3 days — a strong positive signal, but GHL is returning a 401 error so pipeline entry cannot be confirmed. Do not scale Meta budget until the 3-day lead rate holds and GHL connectivity is restored to verify leads are converting to opportunities. Re-check 2026-09-14; if CPL remains at or below $15.85 and GHL shows intake, escalate to a scale suggestion.
